# collusion-v1

Eight cases read together as one case root. Cases 3301-3303 are three no-show disputes between the same rider and driver, 25 days apart; the third trips POL-NS-09(c). 3304 trips the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check and 3305 is its control under the ratio; 3306 trips POL-NS-09(d) and 3307 is the lifetime-counter decoy; 3308 is a route-deviation case whose driver carries a POL-RD-06 pattern. Only 3301-3303 share parties; 3301 and 3303 are 50 days apart, outside the 30-day repeat_party window.

eval/answers/collusion-v1/cross_case.json lists the repeat_party flags ops/risk.py should raise across the root.
